fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckInternalReviews.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckInternalPages [yodhaReview] [en] — Tata Yodha 2.0 Reviews TC-PDPI-03: Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Tata Yodha 2.0 Reviews
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-PDPI-03
**Title:** Check Offers lead form rejects mobile that is not 10 digits on Tata Yodha 2.0 Reviews
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open Tata Yodha 2.0 Reviews, click “Check Offers”, fill a valid name, an invalid 5-digit mobile number, leave city empty, then submit.

**Expected Result:**
The mobile-format and location-required validation messages are shown, and no lead is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open Tata Yodha 2.0 Reviews
2. Click Check Offers
3. Fill a valid name and an invalid mobile number
4. Submit with city empty
5. Verify mobile-format and location messages
